item.name: Conner net (mine)
entries: On a failed {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} for a missile or upon detonation for a mine, a conner net deploys on the target, which must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} (DC 15). On a failed save, the ship is {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned} for 1 minute. As an action on each of their turns, a crewmember can have the ship repeat the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}, ending the effect on a success.

item.name: Conner net (missile)
entries: On a failed {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} for a missile or upon detonation for a mine, a conner net deploys on the target, which must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} (DC 15). On a failed save, the ship is {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned} for 1 minute. As an action on each of their turns, a crewmember can have the ship repeat the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}, ending the effect on a success.

item.name: Discord missile
entries: On a failed {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}, the missile deploys pistoeka sabotage or —buzz— droids on the target. At the end of each of the target ship—s turns, the target ship gains one level of system damage if the target is medium or smaller [large or smaller]. As an action on each of their turns, a crewmember can have the ship attempt their choice of a dexterity or constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC 15), ending the effect on a success.

item.name: EMP bomb
entries: When an EMP bomb detonates, each ship within 150 [300] feet must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} (DC 15). On a failed save, a ship is {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned} for 1 minute. As an action on each of their turns, a crewmember can have the ship repeat the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}, ending the effect on a success.

item.name: Flechette torpedo
entries: A Flechette torpedo detonates at a point within range, creating a 200 (400) foot cube of {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-sotg|difficult terrain}.  Any ship entering or starting their turn in this area must succeed at a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} (DC 15) or take 1d8 [2d8] kinetic damage.

item.name: Glop bomb
entries: When a glop bomb detonates, each ship within 50 [100] feet must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} (DC 15). On a failed save, a ship is {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded} for 1 minute. As an action on each of their turns, a crewmember can have the ship repeat the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}, ending the effect on a success.  Ships larger than you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-sotg|advantage} on their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}.

item.name: Gravity bomb
entries: Rather than exploding on contact, gravity bombs detonate any time a ship comes within range of it. When a gravity bomb detonates, it attaches itself to the closest ship hull within 50 [100] feet, creating a mass shadow centered on the ship with a radius of 50 feet that lasts for 10 minutes.  A ship can attempt to dislodge the gravity bomb at the beginning of each ship turn by making a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} (DC 15). Any Large or smaller [Gargantuan or smaller] ships with an attached gravity bomb are unable to activate their hyperdrives.

item.name: Gravity mine
entries: Rather than exploding on contact, gravity mines detonate any time a ship comes within range of it. When a gravity mine detonates, it creates a mass shadow centered on the point of detonation with a radius of 50 [100] feet that lasts for 10 minutes. Any ships touching this mass shadow are unable to activate their hyperdrives.

item.name: Proton bomb
entries: When a proton bomb detonates, each ship within 100 [200] feet must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} (DC 15). A ship takes 4d10 [8d10] energy damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

item.name: Proximity mine
entries: Rather than exploding on contact, proximity mines detonate any time a ship comes within range of it. When a proximity mine detonates, each ship within 100 [200] feet must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} (DC 15). A ship takes 2d10 [4d10] fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

item.name: Pulse bomb
entries: When a pulse bomb detonates, each ship within 200 [400] feet must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} (DC 15). A ship takes 2d10 [4d10] ion damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Additionally, on a failed save, it is ionized for 1 minute. As an action on each of their turns, a crewmember can have the ship repeat the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}, ending the effect on a success.  Ships larger than you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-sotg|advantage} on their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}.

item.name: S-thread tracer
entries: On a failed {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw}, the missile latches an S-thread tracer onto the target. When making an Intelligence (Probe) check to detect the S-threaded ship's hyperspace travel, its angle of departure can be detected on a roll of 15 instead of 25.

item.name: Seismic charge
entries: When a seismic charge detonates, each ship within 150 [300] feet must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg|saving throw} (DC 15). A ship takes 1d10 [2d10] kinetic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
